fields.acceptance: A testscript runs a workflow whose step fails and shows its cleanup step ran and the run still failed, and a workflow whose cleanup step exits 1 still ending done with the failure in the journal; internal/workflow parse tests cover the new section.
fields.statement: A workflow file may declare cleanup steps, command steps that run once, in order, when a run of the workflow ends done, failed or abandoned, in the run's worktree with the run's environment; a failing cleanup step is journalled and logged and never changes the run's result; the built-in workflows declare none.

fields.acceptance: internal/workflow and workflow-check testscripts cover a valid and an invalid cleanup section; describe-golden and the generated reference are regenerated.
fields.statement: rhiza workflow check and workflow describe cover cleanup steps: check rejects a cleanup step that is not a command step or names a next step, and describe and the generated workflow-file reference show the cleanup section.
